title: 第21章 飞鹏鱼的进阶方案第22章 黑甲虫
content_zh:
随后，李衍道想起一事，从储物袋中取出一块泛黄的玉简，递给爷爷，
“爷爷，我记得父亲修炼的是火属性功法，这块玉简记载了关于炼丹的知识。
虽然有些残缺，仅包含一阶下品风清丹的炼制方法，但也许对他有所帮助。”
李松鹤接过玉简，眉宇间透出思索之色，“你这是想让林一开始学习炼丹术么？”
“的确有此打算，”李衍道坦诚道，“炼丹之道博大精深，非一日之功可成，首先要看父亲是否具备相应的天赋。
而为了家族长远计，我计划大规模种植风清草。
单纯出售草药，收益有限，仅略高于灵米的价值。
所以，培养家族的炼丹师便显得尤为重要，若能成功，未来家族或许能因此而更进一步。”
听到孙儿如此深谋远虑，李松鹤的脸上浮现出一丝欣慰的笑容。
“如此甚好，”李松鹤点头赞许，“另外，周鸿瑜拥有中品木灵根，我打算将从琉璃宗带回来的木属性功法传授给她，说不定将来也能成为一名出色的灵植师。”
面对爷爷的安排，李衍道微笑着表示赞同，“爷爷考虑得周全，这样安排再合适不过了。”
简单交流了几句后，李衍道便告退，回到了自己的阁楼之中。
心念一动间，他踏入水衍珠内。
此前他所购得的三条飞鹏鱼，曾意外地引发了水衍珠的反应，这让他心中充满了好奇。
时间在专注的研究下悄然流逝，转眼便是整整两日过去。
在风林岛上的一处山头，老者与周鸿瑜并肩而坐，望着远方的景色，老者不禁发出了一声轻叹。
“鸿瑜啊，李家显然还处于起步阶段，连最基本的护岛大阵都尚未建立，这让我不禁怀疑，将你留在这里是否真的是最佳选择。”
周鸿瑜闻言，神色平静，她轻轻开口道：“爷爷，既然已经来到这里，便应随遇而安。
李家那位公子显然有着不同凡响的实力。
对于我这种拥有中品灵根的人来说，能够依附于一个练气期家族已是十分幸运，不必过分奢求加入更为强大的筑基势力。

即便有机会进入筑基势力，也未必能够得到应有的尊重，说不定还会沦为当婢女的命。”
她顿了顿，继续说道：“更何况，李家对我们颇为照顾。
就拿昨天来说，那位李家老者特意送来了《青木诀》这部功法。
其品质远胜于我们原先修习的《五行诀》，而且非常适合我的木属性灵根。
若真如那位公子所说，或许我真的有机会突破至筑基期也未可知。”
“好吧，既然你能如此明理，我也就放心了。
那位李衍道公子的确非同凡响，或许跟随他，真能有一番未来。”
言罢，祖孙二人相视一笑，心中的忧虑似乎也随之烟消云散。
与此同时，在另一座山峰上，李衍道正处于水衍珠内的世界中。
他此刻正放声大笑，喜悦之情溢于言表。
在进入水衍珠后，当他触碰到那几条飞鹏鱼时，竟意外地获得了来自水衍珠的反馈。
content_en:
Later, Li Yandao remembered something and took out a yellowed jade slip from his storage bag and handed it to his grandfather.
"Grandpa, I remember that my father practiced fire-based exercises, and this jade slip records the knowledge about alchemy.
Although it is a bit incomplete and only contains the refining method of the first-order low-grade Fengqing Dan, it may be helpful to him. "
Li Songhe took the jade slip with a thoughtful look on his eyebrows, "Do you want Lin Yi to start learning alchemy?"
"I do have this plan," Li Yandao said frankly, "The art of alchemy is profound and profound, and it cannot be accomplished in a day. First of all, it depends on whether the father has the corresponding talent.
For the long-term plan of my family, I plan to plant Fengqingcao on a large scale.
Simply selling herbal medicines would result in limited profits, only slightly higher than the value of spiritual rice.
Therefore, it is particularly important to cultivate the family's alchemist. If successful, the family may be able to go further in the future. "
Hearing his grandson's foresight, a smile of relief appeared on Li Songhe's face.
"That's very good," Li Songhe nodded in approval, "In addition, Zhou Hongyu has a medium-grade wood spirit root. I plan to teach her the wood attribute skills brought back from Liuli Sect. Maybe she can become an outstanding spirit planter in the future."
Faced with Grandpa's arrangement, Li Yandao smiled and agreed, "Grandpa has thought carefully, and this arrangement is perfect."
After a few brief exchanges, Li Yandao resigned and returned to his attic.
With a thought in his mind, he stepped into the Water Yan Pearl.
The three Feipeng fish he purchased before unexpectedly triggered Shui Yanzhu's reaction, which made him full of curiosity.
Time passed quietly under the focused study, and two full days passed in the blink of an eye.
On a hilltop on Fenglin Island, the old man and Zhou Hongyu sat side by side. Looking at the scenery in the distance, the old man couldn't help but sigh.
"Hongyu, the Li family is obviously still in its infancy. Even the most basic island protection formation has not yet been established. This makes me wonder whether keeping you here is really the best choice."
Zhou Hongyu looked calm when she heard this, and she said softly: "Grandpa, since you have come here, you should take things as they come.
The young master of the Li family obviously has extraordinary strength.
For people like me who have middle-grade spiritual roots, I am very lucky to be attached to a family in the Qi training stage, and there is no need to excessively expect to join a more powerful foundation-building force.
Even if there is a chance to join the foundation-building force, they may not be able to get the respect they deserve, and they may even end up being a maid. "
She paused and continued: "What's more, the Li family takes good care of us.
Take yesterday for example, the old man from the Li family specially sent the "Qingmu Jue" technique.
Its quality is far better than the "Five Elements Jue" we originally practiced, and it is very suitable for my wood attribute spiritual root.
If it's true what that young master said, maybe I really have a chance to break through to the foundation building stage. "
"Well, since you can be so sensible, I feel relieved.
That Young Master Li Yandao is indeed extraordinary. Maybe if you follow him, you can have a bright future. "
After saying this, the grandfather and grandson looked at each other and smiled, and the worries in their hearts seemed to disappear.
At the same time, on another mountain peak, Li Yandao was in the world inside the Shuiyan Pearl.
He was laughing loudly at this moment, his joy was beyond words.
After entering the Shui Yanzhu, when he touched the flying peng fish, he unexpectedly received feedback from the Shui Yanzhu.
